comments.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
comments.text: 🚡 One of the wildest things about Medellín is that it built cable cars as real public transportation, connecting hillside neighborhoods directly to the metro below.

comments.author: @GlobeRealLife360
comments.text: It’s chilling to see how 'theme park' tourism is pricing locals out of the very neighborhoods they fought to keep safe. The cost of Medellín's transformation seems a lot heavier than the travel brochures suggest.

comments.author: @uncensoredworldtravel
comments.text: It’s wild to see how a city can transform so much, yet the gap between the glitzy El Poblado and the mountain slopes remains so stark. Gentrification is a double-edged sword for the locals.

comments.author: @AmazingDiscoveriesTopUS
comments.text: Medellin went from one of the world's most dangerous cities to a global tourist destination. But has tourism gone too far? Would you still visit?

comments.author: @OdysseyDocs
comments.text: For truly delicious coffee, you simply have to visit Vietnam—the coffee capital of the world—where you can enjoy incredibly tasty egg coffee or refreshing iced coffee with condensed milk.

comments.author: @AtlasDiscover1
comments.text: Grabbing a hot tinto from a street cart on a busy corner for pocket change shows the true heart of local daily life. That unpretentious street side food scene with fresh empanadas and strong coffee beats any overpriced tourist cafe in El Poblado. That authentic simplicity is where you taste the real soul of the city.

comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: The foundation of this city is shaking again, but not from an earthquake—from tourists. Seeing poor neighborhoods that police once abandoned turned into 'theme parks' for foreigners, driving rents sky-high, shows the bitter price of development. Do you think tourism is saving or destroying Medellín? 🏙💸

comments.author: @TravelKismet
comments.text: Expats live like kings while locals are priced out! This travel documentary reveals the brutal life in Medellín. A stunning woman in a gentrified culture fighting to survive. Mind blowing facts!
